subject: economics
objective: What are the unemployment and participation rates?
instruction: The Eastmark national survey reports: The labour force is 85,400,000, the number employed is 80,926,000 and the working-age population is 131,200,000. Unemployed = labour force - employed. Unemployment rate = unemployed / labour force. Participation rate = labour force / working-age population. Employment-population ratio = employed / working-age population. Required: unemployed, unemployment rate, participation rate, employment population ratio.
